description: Every finite intersection of the side choices from an independent family, together with cofinite subsets, is infinite.
signature:

  (hT : ↑T ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices A ε) : (⋂₀ ↑T).Infinite
